cases.description: Passing a null BarSeries should cause a NullPointerException when the method tries to retrieve prices
Position has a null entry trade; calling getGrossReturn should raise an IllegalStateException (or NPE) because entry price cannot be obtained
Position has a null exit trade; calling getGrossReturn should raise an IllegalStateException (or NPE) because exit price cannot be obtained

Entry price is extremely small (0.0001) and exit price is very large (1000) → gross return should be a huge positive number, testing numeric stability
